password.description: Omit to generate a temporary password (returned once; must be changed).

BoardElectricalLimits.description: Electrical values used by circuit validation. Operating limits only, never absolute maximum ratings.
BoardElectricalLimits.title: BoardElectricalLimits

message.description: English text for logs and API clients; the UI uses code.
message.title: Message

params.description: Values for the localized UI message, e.g. estimated current.
params.title: Params

ComponentDefinition.description: Definition of a board or component type. Geometry is in grid units (integers, 1 unit = 2.54 mm).
ComponentDefinition.title: ComponentDefinition

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error codes. The UI relies only on these values.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

data.description: Intel HEX text of the application image (without bootloader).
data.title: Data

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the Intel HEX text.
sha256.title: Sha256

GpioGroupCurrentLimit.description: Limit for the sum of currents of a group of MCU port pins.
GpioGroupCurrentLimit.title: GpioGroupCurrentLimit

teacherId.description: Admin only: owner teacher (defaults to the caller).
teacherId.title: Teacherid

active.description: Not revoked, not expired and uses left.
active.title: Active

IssueCode.description: Stable machine-readable circuit issue codes. The UI relies only on these values.
IssueCode.title: IssueCode

kind.description: component: board or component id; connection: wire id; pin: componentId.pinId; net: netlist id; field: document field path.

LedModel.description: Light-emitting diode; forward voltage in volts comes from a number property.
LedModel.title: LedModel

LocalizedText.description: UI text: translation key plus the Russian text.
LocalizedText.title: LocalizedText

PinPosition.description: Pin position in grid units, relative to the top-left corner of the symbol.
PinPosition.title: PinPosition

circuit.description: Defaults to an empty circuit with the board only.
circuit.title: Circuit

code.description: Defaults to an empty sketch skeleton.
code.title: Code

access.description: viewer: read-only access (teacher of the owner's group or admin).
access.title: Access

ProjectSummary.description: Проект без кода и схемы (для списка).
ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary

ProjectUpdate.description: Частичное изменение: отсутствующие (или null) поля не меняются.

revision.description: Revision the change is based on; a mismatch returns REVISION_CONFLICT.
revision.title: Revision

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

RefKind.description: Kind of the object an issue refers to.
RefKind.title: RefKind

ResistorModel.description: Two-terminal resistor; resistance in ohms comes from a number property.
ResistorModel.title: ResistorModel

data.description: Text sent to UART0 RX as UTF-8 (at most 4096 bytes).
data.title: Data

Severity.description: Issue severity: ERROR blocks compilation and simulation, WARNING and INFO do not.
Severity.title: Severity

appliedCycle.description: Cycle at which the simulator applied the command (time-slice boundary).
appliedCycle.title: Appliedcycle

cycle.description: MCU clock cycle (16 MHz) of the last known state.
cycle.title: Cycle

errorCode.description: Code of the error that ended the session.
errorCode.title: Errorcode

timestamp.description: Simulated time in microseconds since power-on.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

SimulationStartErrorResponse.description: Error envelope of the start endpoint with the result that blocked the start.
SimulationStartErrorResponse.title: SimulationStartErrorResponse

compilation.description: Compilation result; firmware is always null here (it is sent to the simulator only).

validation.description: Circuit issues (warnings and infos only: errors block the start).

session.description: Active or last session; null if none.

SwitchModel.description: Switch between two terminals; open or closed at run time.
SwitchModel.title: SwitchModel

VisualModel.description: Symbol size and pin positions relative to the top-left corner, in grid units.
VisualModel.title: VisualModel
